comparison.objective: Open breaker clamps, insert a comb busbar, and tighten three screws; candidate depins one connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated screw operation and simultaneous multi-pin busbar alignment versus recessed twin-tang depression and bimanual wire extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Requires all pins seated and clamped with the tool put down; candidate requires the selected terminal removed and all other contacts retained. Candidate force thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The breaker task tests multi-pin installation and screw clamping, not selective contact release.
